valve_to_seat_volume_cm3.tag: ESTIMATE: hose 12.35 / fittings 1.0 / manifold 4.51 from Combustion v2p3 (DERIVED/ASSUMED); E1-M items analytic from the design geometry; cartridge solid fraction 30 % ASSUMED

C2.entry: top of the 10 mm bore (cross-drilling top edge flush with the bore top)
C2.note: flow-through manifold; filter bore is in series (flow-through), not a dead leg

C3.note: single top entry as v3.3 (no low entry): feed symmetry as v3.3 / Combustion E1

C4.note: no N2O passage borders a chamber-gas seal: filter bore, axial drillings and transfer are in solid metal above the plug glands; every N2O seal (block face, cartridge cap, transfer, bonnet face) separates N2O from AMBIENT

C5.note: 15 um cartridge in the head cap, downstream of the hose and of the riser socket weld; v3.3 bonnet screen seat deleted

C7.note: pre-purge or T-gated check; volume +7 cm3 vs O3b estimate -> purge time scales ~ with volume

trapped_volume_relief.location: teed at the NC valve outlet (coil fixed end, OFF the gimbal): one liquid volume valve->seat, no internal check, so one device covers hose + riser + block + filter + manifold
trapped_volume_relief.P_set: PARAMETER P_set_trapped: must lie above the highest normal static pressure at that point (tank MEOP 7.0 MPa) and reach full flow at <= 7.5 MPa (Combustion C6): window 7.0-7.5 MPa incl. set tolerance and accumulation (e.g. 7.2 MPa +/-3 %): TIGHT -> lead decision: lower the tank relief set / MEOP or accept a burst disc at 7.5 MPa

capacity.basis: V 27.9 cm3 x beta 0.01234 1/K x dT/dt 2.0 K/s (ASSUMED bound)

trapped_volume_relief.destination: overboard through a short tube pointing aft-outboard, away from the torch, the hot case and the servo bay
trapped_volume_relief.candidate: proportional relief valve, 1/8-1/4 in, soft seat FKM, N2O/oxygen-clean (Swagelok R3A class AS RECALLED, TO-QUOTE, Sønderborg DK-6400); mass ~60-110 g ASSUMED (off the gimbal)
trapped_volume_relief.alternative_rejected: check valve in parallel with the NC valve back to the tank: a forward leak of the check bypasses the NC isolation valve (ENG-05/ENG-16 fail-safe shutoff) -> not baselined

tank_relief.P_set: PARAMETER P_set_tank (set below the tank proof, T-vent per ENG-09)
tank_relief.note: Combustion/lead own the set point; Mechanical needs mass and envelope for the airframe ICD

remote_vent.type: NC solenoid valve on the tank vapour space, ground-commanded (ENG-16 remote vent)
remote_vent.requirements: >= 7.5 MPa rating, N2O-compatible seals, orifice >= 1 mm, coil 12 V class, fails closed
